```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(backgammonr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

This notebook compares Thompson to the main non-Thompson baselines on the same `1-6` opening problem.

The main function is `bg_compare_algorithms()`.

- `methods` is the list of allocation rules being compared.
- `budgets` is the budget grid.
- `seeds` is the repeated-seed set.
- `proxy_references` is the saved 1-6 truth from the first notebook.
- `save_path` is the permanent study file.

```{r settings}
truth_budget <- 100000L
roll_1_6_truth_path <- file.path(
  "artifacts",
  "opening_truths",
  paste0("opening_1-6_truth_budget_", truth_budget, ".rds")
)

if (!file.exists(roll_1_6_truth_path)) {
  stop("Run 01_save_all_21_opening_truths.Rmd first so the 1-6 truth file exists.")
}

comparison_budgets <- c(16L, 32L, 64L, 128L, 256L, 512L)
comparison_seeds <- 1:25
comparison_methods <- c("thompson", "ucb", "equal")
comparison_overwrite <- FALSE

study_dir <- file.path("artifacts", "studies")
dir.create(study_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

comparison_path <- file.path(
  study_dir,
  "opening_1-6_thompson_vs_non_thompson.rds"
)

truth_1_6 <- bg_truth_load(roll_1_6_truth_path)

problem_1_6 <- bg_problem(
  state = bg_initial_board(),
  roll = bg_roll(1L, 6L),
  simulation_policy = "random",
  reward_model = "scalar_payoff",
  posterior_model = "beta_pseudo",
  problem_id = "opening_1-6"
)
```

```{r comparison-run}
comparison_1_6 <- bg_compare_algorithms(
  problems = problem_1_6,
  methods = comparison_methods,
  budgets = comparison_budgets,
  seeds = comparison_seeds,
  proxy_references = truth_1_6$reference,
  save_path = comparison_path,
  overwrite = comparison_overwrite
)
```

```{r comparison-eval}
comparison_eval <- bg_eval_reference_aware(
  comparison_1_6,
  truth = truth_1_6$reference,
  top_k = 3L
)

comparison_summary <- aggregate(
  comparison_eval[, c(
    "top1_match",
    "simple_regret",
    "selected_reference_rank",
    "recommended_prob_best",
    "spearman",
    "share_best_truth",
    "allocation_entropy"
  )],
  by = list(
    allocation_policy = comparison_eval$allocation_policy,
    checkpoint = comparison_eval$checkpoint
  ),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

comparison_summary <- comparison_summary[
  order(comparison_summary$allocation_policy, comparison_summary$checkpoint),
]

knitr::kable(
  comparison_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Average method performance for Thompson, UCB, and equal allocation."
)
```

```{r final-budget-table}
final_budget_summary <- comparison_eval[comparison_eval$checkpoint == max(comparison_budgets), ]
final_budget_summary <- aggregate(
  final_budget_summary[, c(
    "top1_match",
    "simple_regret",
    "selected_reference_rank",
    "recommended_prob_best",
    "spearman",
    "share_best_truth",
    "allocation_entropy"
  )],
  by = list(allocation_policy = final_budget_summary$allocation_policy),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

knitr::kable(
  final_budget_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Average performance at the largest budget."
)
```

```{r runtime-table}
runtime_summary <- aggregate(
  comparison_1_6$results[, c("runtime_seconds", "rollout_throughput")],
  by = list(
    allocation_policy = comparison_1_6$results$allocation_policy,
    checkpoint = comparison_1_6$results$checkpoint
  ),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

knitr::kable(
  runtime_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Average runtime and throughput by method and budget."
)
```

```{r budget-curve-regret, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_budget_curve(
  comparison_1_6,
  metric = "simple_regret",
  truth = truth_1_6$reference
)
```

```{r budget-curve-match, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_budget_curve(
  comparison_1_6,
  metric = "top1_match",
  truth = truth_1_6$reference
)
```

```{r budget-curve-rank, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_budget_curve(
  comparison_1_6,
  metric = "spearman",
  truth = truth_1_6$reference
)
```

```{r runtime-curve, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(runtime_summary, aes(x = checkpoint, y = runtime_seconds, color = allocation_policy)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Runtime by method",
    x = "Budget checkpoint",
    y = "Runtime (seconds)",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r single-runs}
thompson_single <- bg_ts_run(
  problem = problem_1_6,
  budget = max(comparison_budgets),
  checkpoints = comparison_budgets,
  proxy_reference = truth_1_6$reference,
  seed = 1L
)

ucb_single <- bg_ucb_run(
  problem = problem_1_6,
  budget = max(comparison_budgets),
  checkpoints = comparison_budgets,
  proxy_reference = truth_1_6$reference,
  seed = 1L
)

equal_single <- bg_uniform_run(
  problem = problem_1_6,
  budget = max(comparison_budgets),
  checkpoints = comparison_budgets,
  proxy_reference = truth_1_6$reference,
  seed = 1L
)
```

```{r single-run-summary}
single_run_summary <- rbind(
  thompson_single$checkpoint_table[thompson_single$checkpoint_table$checkpoint == max(comparison_budgets), c(
    "allocation_policy",
    "recommended_move_label",
    "recommended_prob_best",
    "simple_regret",
    "selected_reference_rank",
    "runtime_seconds"
  )],
  ucb_single$checkpoint_table[ucb_single$checkpoint_table$checkpoint == max(comparison_budgets), c(
    "allocation_policy",
    "recommended_move_label",
    "recommended_prob_best",
    "simple_regret",
    "selected_reference_rank",
    "runtime_seconds"
  )],
  equal_single$checkpoint_table[equal_single$checkpoint_table$checkpoint == max(comparison_budgets), c(
    "allocation_policy",
    "recommended_move_label",
    "recommended_prob_best",
    "simple_regret",
    "selected_reference_rank",
    "runtime_seconds"
  )]
)

knitr::kable(
  single_run_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "One representative seed at the largest budget."
)
```
